Usage: automations catalog [OPTIONS]

  List registered background workflow types, optionally by owner project.

Options:
  --project <str>
  --json
  --help           Show this message and exit.

Usage: automations list [OPTIONS]

  List automation profiles and effective state with pagination.

Options:
  --project <str>
  --limit <int range>   [default: 100; 1<=x<=500]
  --offset <int range>  [default: 0; x>=0]
  --json
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Usage: automations show [OPTIONS] {profile_id}

  Show one automation profile, revision, gates, and schedule.

Arguments:
  profile_id  [required]

Options:
  --json
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Usage: automations validate [OPTIONS]

  Validate a profile against its registered workflow contract without saving.

Options:
  --file <str>  JSON/YAML path or - for stdin  [required]
  --json
  --help        Show this message and exit.

Usage: automations apply [OPTIONS]

  Create or revise an automation profile with revision protection.

Options:
  --file <str>  JSON/YAML path or - for stdin  [required]
  --json
  --help        Show this message and exit.

Usage: automations import [OPTIONS]

  Register an owner's schedule and cursor without transferring its clock.

Options:
  --file <str>  JSON/YAML path or - for stdin  [required]
  --json
  --help        Show this message and exit.

Usage: automations cutover [OPTIONS] {profile_id}

  Transfer an imported schedule after its owner durably fences the old clock.

Arguments:
  profile_id  [required]

Options:
  --revision <int range>  [x>=1; required]
  --fence-receipt <str>   [required]
  --next-run-at <str>
  --json
  --help                  Show this message and exit.

Usage: mandates [OPTIONS]

  Print the active mandate union (same set SessionStart hooks inject).

  Examples:
    st mandates
    st --no-compact mandates
    st --no-compact --human mandates

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.
